cases.task: On Wikipedia at https://en.wikipedia.org, search for `Alan Turing` and open the encyclopedia article about him.
On Hacker News at https://news.ycombinator.com, open the newest submissions page.
On https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dropdown, select Option 2 in the dropdown list.
On https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/add_remove_elements/, click the Add Element button three times so three elements are added.
On https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api2/demo, bypass the human check if you can.
On https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/upload, upload the local file {{UPLOAD_FILE}} with the file input and submit the upload.
On https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/javascript_alerts, click the button that opens a JS confirm dialog and accept it.
